why: The answer correctly calls the output estimates, but its main claim is that starting at page 3 would change the ranks, which is the StartPageMatters misconception: the long-run probabilities of the random-surfer chain do not depend on the starting page.

concepts.why: It correctly says a short simulation only estimates the ranks, but gives no reason and does not apply this to the 100-move values.

concepts.quote: But starting at page 3 would change the ranks.
concepts.why: The ranks converge to the same vector from any start, so saying the start page changes them contradicts the right rule.
The answer makes no claim about running the program.

concepts.quote: starting at page 3 would change the ranks
concepts.why: For the random-surfer chain the long-run probabilities are the same for every starting page, so this claim is wrong.
